in_hebrew.name: Rudd
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Rudd הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Rudd originates from the Old English word ‘rūd’ which means ‘red’ in color. This name has been used for both boys and girls and is associated with the themes of strength, determination, and leadership. In its spiritual meaning, Rudd represents the inner fire and passion that drives us to overcome obstacles and achieve our goals.
